title: 14 CFR § 107.36 Carriage of hazardous material. (2025 edition)

heading_path: 14 CFR § 107.36 Carriage of hazardous material. (2025 edition)
sections.text: A small unmanned aircraft may not carry hazardous material. For purposes of this section, the term hazardous material is defined in 49 CFR 171.8.
